arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="plcodex-passive-observer-") as directory:
    root = Path(directory) / "VPS"
    checkout = subprocess.run(["git","clone","--quiet","--depth","1","--branch","main",
             "https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git",str(root)],
             stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45,check=False)
    if checkout.returncode: raise RuntimeError("Supervisor source checkout unavailable")
    sha = subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(root),"rev-parse","HEAD"],
                         capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10).stdout.strip()
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
    from ops import supervisor_cloud_source as cloud,supervisor_audit as audit
    def get(repo,path):
        if repo=="vps":
            if path!="actions/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=50":
                raise RuntimeError("Untrusted VPS API path")
            name="martaxi-boss/VPS"
            maximum=4000000
        elif repo=="project":
            if path!=cloud.PULLS_PATH and not cloud.CHECKS_PATH.fullmatch(path):
                raise RuntimeError("Untrusted project API path")
            name=cloud.CLOUD_REPOSITORY
            maximum=1000000
        else: raise RuntimeError("Invalid repository name")
        url="https://api.github.com/repos/"+name+"/"+path
        req=Request(url,headers={
          "Accept":"application/vnd.github+json",
          "User-Agent":"Existing-Passive-Supervisor",
          "X-GitHub-Api-Version":"2022-11-28"},method="GET")
        try:
            with urlopen(req,timeout=22) as res:
                b=res.read(maximum+1)
            if len(b)>maximum: raise RuntimeError("GitHub public payload exceeded limit")
            return json.loads(b.decode("utf-8"))
        except (HTTPError,URLError,TimeoutError,ValueError):
            raise RuntimeError("Public GitHub observation failed") from None
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    since=cloud.last_observed_start(lambda method,p: get("vps",p) if method=="GET" else None,now)
    notices=cloud.messages(lambda p: get("project",p),since,now,limit=5)
    audited=[audit.observation(m,source="cloud") for m in notices]
    print("SUPERVISOR_EXECUTION_HOST=VPS")
    print("SUPERVISOR_SOURCE_SHA="+sha)
    print("SUPERVISOR_NOTICES="+str(len(audited)))
    for m in audited: print("SUPERVISOR_AUDITED_JSON="+json.dumps(m,ensure_ascii=True))
    print("SUPERVISOR_PUBLIC_AUDIT=PASS")
PY
